note: Audit F42: every store that holds a copy of, or anything derived from, matter or client data, and every other store the gate finds, so that a new one fails ci_gates/check_data_inventory.py until it is classified. Matter vectors: none exist (the only vectors are the public law corpus).

matter_record.classification: client confidential: the matter row (title, court, case number, client link, label)
matter_record.deleter: retention saga (P2 retention.store.purge) after a two-partner approval
matter_record.acknowledgement: deletion_acks/{requestId}_{storeKey} and the request's acked map: purged | anonymised | retained, count and SHA-256 of the sorted ids

matter_access.classification: access control: who may read the matter
matter_access.deleter: the approval transaction (revocation), then the saga for any row written since
matter_access.acknowledgement: deletion_acks/{requestId}_{storeKey} and the request's acked map: purged | retained, count and id hash

matter_content.classification: client confidential or privileged: documents, OCR text, drafts, evidence, AI outputs, filing records of a matter
matter_content.deleter: retention saga after a two-partner approval; retention.apply for periodic deletion
matter_content.acknowledgement: deletion_acks/{requestId}_{storeKey} and the request's acked map: purged | anonymised | retained, count and id hash

derived_index.classification: derived from matter records: search and reporting rows (labels, titles, counts)
derived_index.deleter: retention saga after a two-partner approval
derived_index.acknowledgement: deletion_acks/{requestId}_{storeKey} and the request's acked map: purged | retained, count and id hash

ai_record.classification: AI spend and attempt metadata keyed to a matter (no prompt or answer text)
ai_record.deleter: retention saga (anonymise: matterId set to null) after a two-partner approval; retention.apply
ai_record.acknowledgement: deletion_acks/{requestId}_{storeKey} and the request's acked map: anonymised | purged | retained, count and id hash

job_record.classification: P2 job rows: ids, codes and payload ids of a matter's background work
job_record.deleter: retention saga after a two-partner approval (the saga's own jobs are firm-level and never match)
job_record.acknowledgement: deletion_acks/{requestId}_{storeKey} and the request's acked map: purged | retained, count and id hash

legacy_matter_ops.classification: legacy Next workflow-ops and filing-escalation rows; a row with matterId is a matter record (free-text reasons)
legacy_matter_ops.deleter: retention saga after a two-partner approval (rows whose matterId is the matter)
legacy_matter_ops.acknowledgement: deletion_acks/{requestId}_{storeKey} and the request's acked map: purged | retained, count and id hash

conflict_register.classification: conflict register: client and party names, links, conflict checks
conflict_register.deleter: nobody on matter deletion (retained for future conflict screens, spec R8)
conflict_register.acknowledgement: deletion_acks/{requestId}_{storeKey} and the request's acked map: retained

audit_trail.classification: audit trail: ids, codes, hashes; includes the deletion trail itself
audit_trail.deleter: nobody on matter deletion (the trail of the deletion survives)
audit_trail.acknowledgement: deletion_acks/{requestId}_{storeKey} and the request's acked map: not_applicable (not keyed by matter) or retained

operational_ttl.classification: operational keys and counters; an idempotency effect may hold a response body
operational_ttl.deleter: Firestore TTL (F32) for the ttl stores; not keyed by matter otherwise
operational_ttl.acknowledgement: deletion_acks/{requestId}_{storeKey} and the request's acked map: expiry with the window end, or not_applicable

identity_platform.classification: firm, user, MFA, session and platform rows; personal data of staff, not keyed by matter
identity_platform.acknowledgement: deletion_acks/{requestId}_{storeKey} and the request's acked map: not_applicable

firm_governance.classification: firm-level governance, configuration and aggregates; not keyed by matter
firm_governance.acknowledgement: deletion_acks/{requestId}_{storeKey} and the request's acked map: not_applicable

vault_object.classification: client confidential or privileged: encrypted original document bytes (F03), COMPLIANCE-locked (F33)
vault_object.deleter: a vault_object_tombstones row per object, written with the document row's deletion; an R2 lifecycle rule deletes after the lock if no hold (NOT DEMONSTRATED live)
vault_object.acknowledgement: deletion_acks/{requestId}_{storeKey} and the request's acked map: lock_pending with the object count and the latest lock end, or retained

third_party_trace.classification: self-hosted Opik traces: masked prompt and response at ranks 0 to 3
third_party_trace.deleter: the operator, from the deletion_external_requests row (the Opik deletion call is NOT DEMONSTRATED)
third_party_trace.acknowledgement: deletion_acks/{requestId}_{storeKey} and the request's acked map: external_requested with the trace count, not_applicable when none was exported, or retained

backup.classification: F33 backups of every Firestore or Postgres row
backup.deleter: expiry under the backup retention (F33 configuration); not deleted early
backup.acknowledgement: deletion_acks/{requestId}_{storeKey} and the request's acked map: expiry with the window end

public_corpus.classification: public law corpus and its vectors; no client or matter data
public_corpus.deleter: out of scope of matter deletion
public_corpus.acknowledgement: deletion_acks/{requestId}_{storeKey} and the request's acked map: not_applicable
